sentences.japanese: 顔がきれいでも、心が醜ければ価値はない。
sentences.english: Beauty without goodness is worth nothing.

sentences.japanese: 間近から見ると、ものごとはその欠点や本来備わる醜さを露わにする傾向がある。
sentences.english: Seen close-up, things have a way of showing their defects, their innate ugliness.

sentences.japanese: その大きな醜い木がその家の美観を損ねている。
sentences.english: The big ugly tree destroys the beauty of the house.

sentences.japanese: その醜い肉屋の旦那はあの想像上の怪物に似ている。
sentences.english: That ugly butcher resembles that fictional monster.

sentences.japanese: その絵は醜いとは思わない。それどころか、むしろ美しいと思う。
sentences.english: That picture doesn't seem ugly to me; on the contrary, I think it's rather beautiful.
